tutorial_instructions.en: Change strand count or return geometry; inspect complex strand currents and input/loss balance.
tutorial_instructions.zh-CN: 修改股数或回流几何；检查复电流及输入功率与损耗。

fixed_conventions: SI; exp(+j omega t); RMS; sigma=58 MS/m; mu_r=1; 20 C

en: Insulated strands are connected in parallel only at the ends. The 2D Az weak form couples each conductive region to its unknown axial electric potential gradient. A controlled conducting coaxial return closes the transport problem.

Linearity yields a coupled block system for Az and the source/return voltage gradients. Impose ΣIi=20 A RMS and Ireturn=−20 A; every strand shares the source voltage gradient, while each complex Ii follows from integrating its solved current density.

Compute bundle and return Joule losses separately and compare their sum with input real power. Rac,bundle=Pbundle/|It|² is valid for this pure transport case. Seven strands demonstrate the method and do not meet Q2 copper area.
zh-CN: 股线沿途绝缘，仅端部并联。二维 Az 弱形式把各导体区域与未知轴向电势梯度耦合，并用受控同轴铜回流闭合输运问题。
线性模型形成 Az 与源束/回流电势梯度的块系统。施加 ΣIi=20 A RMS、Ireturn=−20 A；各股共享源束电势梯度，复电流 Ii 由求得的电流密度积分得到。
分别积分束线及回流焦耳损耗，与输入有功功率比较。纯输运工况可定义 Rac,bundle=Pbundle/|It|²。七股为方法演示，铜面积不满足 Q2。
